run_demo_server: run the dash demo server on a specified port with an optional watch path
run_demo_server_with_path: run the demo server on port 8901 watching a custom directory path
create_rgb_video_stream: create an IntervalVideoStreamComponent for RGB camera feed with configurable update frequency
create_depth_video_stream: create an IntervalVideoStreamComponent for depth camera feed triggered by the gripper interval
create_realtime_3d_component: create a Realtime3dComponent with a pytorch3d backend point cloud visualization
create_map_video_stream: create an IntervalVideoStreamComponent for a birds-eye obstacle map feed
create_chatbox_component: create a Chatbox component with a JSON chat log file path
build_dash_layout: build a Dash layout with RGB, depth, 3D, map, and chat components in a grid
configure_app_watch_path: configure the app directory watch path via the --path CLI argument
start_svm_watcher: start the svm_watcher data consumer and optionally pause it on startup
